name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
common_faults: excessive incline on the seat taking spinal load (use 80–90° angle)
elbows flared too wide increasing impingement risk
pressing forward rather than directly overhead

substitutions.note: barbell standing version; higher axial and trunk demand
leg drive involved; heavier loads possible

contraindications: shoulder impingement provoked by overhead dumbbell pressing
resistance_profile: hardest mid-range; dumbbells allow arc that can offload the shoulder at full extension

provenance.notes: Seated position reduces lumbar demand vs standing OHP. Independent arms allow accommodating shoulder mechanics. SFR heuristic.
